1.
Heard Sri Ramesh Chandra Agrahari, learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Hasan Abbas, learned counsel appearing for Insurance Company respondent no. 2 and perused the record.

No one is present on behalf of claimant-respondent no. 1.
2.

This first appeal from order under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 has been filed on behalf of appellant, who is owner of vehicle against the judgment and award dated 18.9.2017 passed by Presiding Officer, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal / Additional District Judge, Court No. 2,
Fatehpur in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 11 of 2017 (Shiv Narayan Versus National Insurance Company Ltd. and others) by which compensation of Rs. 4,23,000/- along with 7% interest, has Amarpreet Singh vs Shiv Narayan And Another on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141604385/
1 been awarded in favour of claimant-respondent and the liability has been fixed upon the appellant,
being owner of the offending TATA Crane.

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that TATA Crane of the appellant bearing registration No. USV 9958 was insured with respondent no. 2 Insurance Company and the claims tribunal has erred in deciding Issue No. 3 holding that the offending TATA Crane was not insured with the Insurance Company on the date of accident.

It is further submitted by learned counsel for appellant that due to inadvertent mistake relevant policy of the insured TATA Crane could not be filed before the claims tribunal and in its place, policy for other vehicle was filed and as such, the claims tribunal has recorded the finding that the offending vehicle was not insured with the respondent Insurance Company and fixed liability of payment upon the appellant.
4.
The appellant has filed an application under Order XLI Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure annexing insurance policy of offending TATA Crane for the relevant period.
5. This Court vide order dated 22.4.2024 directed the Insurance Company to verify the policy which has been filed as additional evidence in this appeal.

6. In compliance of order dated 22.4.2024, affidavit of compliance has been filed on behalf of respondent no. 2 Insurance Company on 10.7.2024 admitting insurance of offending TATA Crane on the date of accident.

7. Cause shown in the affidavit filed in support of application filed under Order XLI, Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure for non filing of insurance policy of offending crane before the claims tribunal, is sufficient.
The application under Order XLI, Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure is allowed and the insurance policy filed as Annexure 1 is accepted as additional evidence.
8. Since the insurance of crane of the appellant was admitted by Insurance Company, it is the Insurance Company, who alone is liable to pay compensation.
9. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 2 Insurance Company did not dispute the aforesaid facts.
10. In view of above, this First Appeal From Order filed on behalf of appellant, who is owner of the offending TATA Crane, is allowed.

The judgement and award dated 18.9.2017 passed by Presiding Officer, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Fatehpur in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 11 of 2017 (Shiv Narayan Versus National Insurance Company Ltd.) is modified to the extent that the respondent no. 2 Insurance Company (opposite party in the claim petition) is liable to pay compensation to the claimant-respondent no. 1.
11.
